aqueous_mineral_classes.spectral_rgb_composite: CRISM PHY Browse (R = D2300, G = BD2210, B = BD1900)
aqueous_mineral_classes.formation_environment: Subsurface/surface aqueous alteration, near-neutral to mildly alkaline pH, high water-to-rock ratio
aqueous_mineral_classes.habitability_rating: HIGH (benign pH, sustained liquid water activity)
aqueous_mineral_classes.preservation_potential: EXCELLENT (interlayer entrapment of organic carbon, macromolecular shielding from UV/oxidants)

aqueous_mineral_classes.spectral_rgb_composite: CRISM SUL Browse (R = BD2100, G = SINDEX2, B = BD1900)
key_mars_occurrences: Valles Marineris (Interior Layered Deposits: Candor & Melas Chasmata)
aqueous_mineral_classes.formation_environment: Evaporative playa/lacustrine brines, acidic groundwater upwelling, volcanic SO2 degassing
aqueous_mineral_classes.habitability_rating: MODERATE TO MARGINAL (variable pH, high ionic strength/salinity, low water activity aw)
aqueous_mineral_classes.preservation_potential: HIGH TO MODERATE (rapid crystalline entombment of microbes and organic acids, though jarosite indicates oxidizing conditions)

aqueous_mineral_classes.class: Ancient Water-Altered Rocks (Carbonates, Opaline Silica, Zeolites)
diagnostic_bands: 2.21-2.26 µm (broad Si-OH asymmetric absorption for silica)
aqueous_mineral_classes.spectral_rgb_composite: CRISM CR2 / HYS Browse (R = MIN2295_2480, G = BD2500, B = BD1900)
aqueous_mineral_classes.formation_environment: CO2-rich groundwater alteration of ultramafic basalt, alkaline lacustrine precipitation, epithermal/fumarolic hot springs
aqueous_mineral_classes.habitability_rating: HIGH (buffered circumneutral to alkaline pH, hydrothermal energy gradients)
aqueous_mineral_classes.preservation_potential: EXCEPTIONAL (fine-grained opaline silica and sparry carbonate cements represent Gold Standard terrestrial biosignature taphonomy)
